fw_catalogue_of_the_regrowth.turn_in_text:
Moonflowers in the craters already? That's a year ahead of what I expected.

This is wonderful. I'll write it all down tonight. Most people wouldn't walk all that way for some flowers.

fw_highborne_stonework.turn_in_text:
Look at that. There's not a gap you could fit a hair into.

This is going to keep me up at night for months, in the best way.

fw_honey_for_the_lodge.turn_in_text:
This will see the lodge through the cold months, and there's enough for the volunteers' kitchen too.

Luis says our honey's the best he's had. I've decided to believe him. Take this from the lodge.

fw_ironbark_the_blighted.turn_in_text:
He's still, and the woods feel lighter, even from here.

That was a hard thing to ask, and you did it.

fw_roots_in_clean_ground.turn_in_text:
These are warm, and that's a good sign. It means the old growth is still alive under all that anger.

We'll plant them along the Fel Line, where the ground needs reminding. The glade will be quieter for a while, and so will I.

fw_something_grows_under_tanaris.turn_in_text:
There's moss in this one. Living moss, sealed in amber, and it's still green.

You don't know what you've given me. This might be the most important thing anybody's brought to this town.

fw_the_chained_ancient.turn_in_text:
He's free now. I felt it the moment he went.

The forest has one more guardian resting now, and one less weapon in the Council's hands. That was a kindness, and a hard one.

fw_the_morlosaren_watch.turn_in_text:
So the tower's still standing. I'll send two of my people down there with a lantern.

That watch guarded the road for three hundred years, and it deserves to guard it a while longer.

fw_voralith_the_turncloak.turn_in_text:
So it's finished, and so is he.

I'll put his name back on the Morlos'Aren stone. Not for him, but for the Sentinels he betrayed, so they have the whole story.

fw_what_lives_in_the_maw.turn_in_text:
Two of them slept through the night. No dreams, they said.

I don't understand it, and I've stopped needing to.

fw_what_the_fel_does.turn_in_text:
These are fascinating. They're burning without burning.

I think I can make something out of these, given time. Not a cure, maybe, but something to slow it down.
